findings_addressed.oracle: Pre-seeds tool_panel.sandbox_panel and tool_panel.panels['sandbox'] with a real _MinimalSandboxPanel QWidget stub before calling _on_open_sandbox_panel, bypassing the unavailable Windows Sandbox / WDAG backend. Asserts three independent runtime outcomes: (1) start_tool_called is True - the slot invoked start_tool() at line 3041; (2) tool_panel._pending_sandbox_bridge is not None - wire_sandbox_bridge was called at line 3040; (3) tool_panel.get_panel('sandbox') is the exact pre-seeded stub - the panels dict is consistent.
documented_mutations: Change panel.start_tool() to panel.stop_tool() at line 3041 in _on_open_sandbox_panel -> start_tool_called stays False -> assertion (1) fails.
Remove self.tool_panel.wire_sandbox_bridge(bridge) at line 3040 -> _pending_sandbox_bridge stays None -> assertion (2) fails.
Remove self.panels['sandbox'] = qwidget inside _create_sandbox_panel (line 1934) -> get_panel('sandbox') returns None -> assertion (3) fails.

notes: Replaced the formerly-weak test_open_sandbox_panel_resolves_via_get_panel with test_open_sandbox_panel_drives_full_post_panel_path. The old test relied on recording get_panel calls but the production code returns early at line 3037 when add_sandbox_tab() returns None (unavailable backend), so get_panel was never called and the 'unconditional' assertion was unreachable in CI. The new test pre-seeds tool_panel.sandbox_panel with a real _MinimalSandboxPanel QWidget stub so add_sandbox_tab() short-circuits at line 1906-1907 (sandbox_panel is not None), delivering execution through the full post-panel body (lines 3039-3052). Three independent falsifiable gates replaced the single unreachable assertion. Also added pyqtSignal import and moved SandboxPanelProtocol to TYPE_CHECKING block per TC001.
